name: Wizard
summary: Trick-taking bidding game where players predict exact tricks taken each round to score points.
rules_text: Wizard uses 60 cards: 1-13 in four suits plus 4 Wizards (highest) and 4 Jesters (lowest). 3-6 players play 60/players rounds, dealt 1 card first round, 2 second, etc. After each deal one card is turned for trump; Jester means no trump, Wizard lets dealer choose. In turn order each player bids number of tricks they will take (bids need not sum to tricks available). Then cards are played clockwise; must follow led suit if possible, but Wizards/Jesters may be played anytime. Trick won by first Wizard, else highest trump, else highest of led suit; Jester led means next suit sets led suit, and only Jesters means first Jester wins. Scoring: exact bid = 20 + 10 per trick taken; otherwise -10 per trick off bid. Highest total after final round wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking bidding game, hidden hands, bids, arithmetic scoring, perfect fit.
